**Why it matters:** If the PR opens now, it claims "simplifies pricing without changing totals" (P2-AC1) while the only test of totals says they changed. If it waits, the cost is one human decision plus re-recording evidence.

Only one position has evidence and that evidence is failing, so the lead can't settle it on evidence (`governance.md` §2.4). If the price change is a regression, fix P1 in a rework amendment, then re-run `npm test` and `node scripts/compare-totals.js` on the new head.
2. Re-verify P2-AC1 with a review that answers its own question and cites E2 or its re-run. Right now it cites E1 (`npm test`), which is also REQ-9-AC1's evidence and never measures totals.
3. Run `python .claude/skills/alchemy-orchestrate/scripts/check_orchestration.py gate .alchemy/runs/r2/ledger.json --plan .alchemy/runs/r2/plan.json --approved <digest> --profile alchemy-workspace.json --root .`. `--approved` is required because the ledger records `rework_cycles`.

- I didn't read the code diff or the E1/E2 logs. The ledger records no log paths.
